culprit_citations.quoted_text: Streamland Media Holdings LLC | cost 4,055 | fair value -

findings.detail: Explicit em-dash fair values in source position rows were left null instead of normalized to zero, causing B01 completeness failure.

rationale: Class 3 anchor-first review: the filing schedule total at table 10 row 20 is $289.479 million and agrees with the extracted quarter total of $289.479 million, so the aggregate fair-value anchor is not bad. The source SOI nevertheless explicitly supplies fair-value entries for zero-valued positions as em dashes, including Wine.com, Inc. at table 9 row 17 and Streamland Media Holdings LLC at table 10 row 6. Treating these source-present zero values as null makes the reported 74/115 non-null completeness a real extraction/normalization defect even though the summed fair value still ties to the filing total.
